title: a launched scratch CodeMother takes its first inspect_wire ask under load
intention: A proof that asks a scratch CodeMother launched by inspect_wire.launch gets its answer under load, never an intermittent InspectRefused "codemother's shim could not take the envelope — it cannot wake a device to receive it".
why: Measured 2026-11-14, n=2: the pre-commit reseal of the tester device (commit b7abd000c) sealed test_the_8p_question_opens_beside_records RED at 17:55:56 on that refusal (tooth test_an_unchanged_file_or_another_skip_beside_them_stays_red, inspect 'resolves_to'), while the same proof runs green 3/3 directly with and without that commit; and 7ea59855b1f4's verdict re-run at 15:14:22 was refused on the same text for test_ask_reaches_a_launched_codemother (inspect 'crossing_named_ticket'). A seal that reds on load, not code, is a hollow red the peers cannot lean on.
traces_to: Law 8 — prove, then trust: a flake makes a seal unleanable; Law 3 — an intermittent verdict is not a measurement of the code it seals.
how: Reproduce first: N concurrent inspect_wire.launch + ask until the refusal appears on main. Then find why no_receiver's hold_name(codemother, wire=True) on the launched scratch bus returns without the envelope taken, and fix launch's readiness (or its ask) inside inspect_wire. A retry loop in a proof is a plaster and refused. If the cause sits in the bus server (cairn/devices/cairn/machines/bus/server.py), cast a sibling on that component (RULE 1) rather than widening these bounds. Unbuilt: cast with the measurement only (orchestrator, 2026-11-14).

clauses.claim: a reproduction of concurrent launched-CodeMother asks reds on main with the 'could not take the envelope' refusal
the same reproduction is green on every run after the build

decisions.text: D1: inspect_wire.launch hands back a CodeMother that takes its first ask (readiness, not retry).
D2: the red-first proof drives concurrent launches and asks, one tooth per clause.

out: cairn/devices/cairn/machines/bus (a cause there is a sibling ticket)

the same proof green 3/3 run directly at b7abd000c (29s) and at 66602c8bb without it (26s)
